title: Large media could overflow the context and markdown asset refs were not resolved

rcca.root_cause: Media parts were capped by count only (no token budget) and markdown asset links were not parsed into asset ids.
rcca.corrective: media_context.chunk_media (budget-bounded, summary fallback) + markdown/AS-* ref resolution wired into selection.
rcca.preventive: Fail-closed over-budget => summary only; refs resolve need-based; text path unchanged.
